name: JW Marriott Desert Springs Resort & Spa
insider_take: This desert oasis sits on 450 sprawling acres where the Coachella Valley's dramatic mountain backdrop meets championship golf and world-class spa indulgence.
whats_special: The resort features two Ted Robinson-designed 18-hole golf courses that wind through desert landscapes and around sparkling lakes. The property is home to one of the largest resort spas in California, plus it's just minutes from the upscale shopping and dining of El Paseo, known as the "Rodeo Drive of the Desert."
pro_tip: Book spa treatments in the afternoon when the desert heat peaks – the cool, tranquil spa environment provides the perfect contrast to Palm Desert's sunny climate.
dont_miss: The resort's stunning atrium lobby with towering palms and flowing water features, plus sunset views from the golf courses with the Santa Rosa Mountains creating a breathtaking silhouette. The nearby Living Desert Zoo & Gardens offers unique desert wildlife experiences just 10 minutes away.
pros: Two championship golf courses designed by Ted Robinson
Full-service Desert Springs Spa with extensive wellness treatments
Multiple dining venues including fine dining and casual options
Luxurious desert oasis setting with beautiful landscaping and water features
cons: Desert location may be remote for some travelers
Resort fees and premium pricing for luxury amenities
